blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – On the 34th day of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, the prosecution presented Land Bank of the Philippines R. Magsaysay Branch Manager Raquel dela Cerna, who testified about the year-end balances of Duterte’s husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, in an account ending in 2730, covering 2022 to 2025. A second LBP witness, San Pedro branch head Eunice Sumatra, was also called to the stand on Tuesday as the prosecution continued building its case on financial records tied to the couple. The proceedings drew renewed attention to the P4.4-billion financial trail involving Duterte and Carpio, comprising 666 covered transaction […]...
